chunks: And whatever was in it from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Nahdī, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī al-Washshāʾ, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Nahdī.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father, from whom the author narrates
key_terms.الْوَشَّاءِ: al-Washshāʾ, a narrator in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: a narrator in the chain of transmission

ai.seo_question: What is the chain of transmission to Abū al-Ḥasan al-Nahdī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Nahdī. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission in hadith literature and preserving the route of attribution in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh.
